Web WrapRank 1
8% of base mana
Channeled20 sec cooldown
Channels a beam of webbing at an enemy, slowing their movement speed by 60% and inflicting 20+0+NatP*0.2 Nature damage every 1 sec for 4 sec.

While active, the target takes 30% increased damage from your other periodic damage effects.

Can be used in any form.
